notes: E-Sys MAX 4.7.5 Shield: when E-Sys's job report says a module turned down an FSC job, E-Sys MAX now explains it as an FSC problem (is the FSC for this module and this car?) instead of a coding file problem. This version also has every fix since 4.7.0: the CAFD editor no longer opens all option folders or jumps the tree after Apply cheat, the battery plate never opens a second connection on F-series and i cars, Connect frees the car at once, and cars show the model BMW sold them as (a G30 540i no longer shows as 535i).
